name: Jiangsu Suzhou Rural Commercial Bank Co., Ltd
summary: Jiangsu Suzhou Rural Commercial Bank Co., Ltd, a financial institution operating across China, delivers a comprehensive suite of banking and financial services to both individual consumers and corporate clients. Its offerings encompass various deposit options, such as current and savings accounts, alongside certificates of deposit. The bank also provides diverse lending facilities, including general loans and specialized financing for corporate entities and small-to-medium enterprises (SMEs). Additional services cover wealth management, digital banking platforms, and card issuance. For international operations, the bank facilitates trade finance and settlement, letters of credit, and foreign currency savings and exchange. Established in 2004, the institution initially operated as Jiangsu Wujiang Rural Commercial Bank Co., Ltd. before adopting its current name, Jiangsu Suzhou Rural Commercial Bank Co., Ltd., in March 2019. Its headquarters are located in Suzhou, China.
